name: year
observations: Partition column. Collection year of the quarter file, not the BLS release year

name: quarter
description: Quarter the data was collected, from 1 to 4

name: consumer_unit_id
description: Identifier of the consumer unit (household), stable across its interviews or diary weeks

name: interview_number
description: Interview number of the consumer unit: 2 to 5 through 2015 (interview 1 was an unreleased bounding interview), 1 to 4 after BLS dropped the bounding interview in 2015

name: newid
description: BLS public-use identifier of the consumer unit and interview or diary week; the last digit is the interview number (1-4) or diary week (1-2)
observations: Unique per interview or diary week

name: reference_month
description: Calendar month the expenditure refers to, from 1 to 12

name: reference_year
description: Calendar year the expenditure refers to

name: expname
description: Name of expense variable from which UCC mapped

name: rtype
description: RECORD TYPE of the corresponding EXPN record

name: gift
description: Was this item bought for someone outside the CU?

name: uccseq
description: Sequence number of UCC in a given mapping

name: cost
description: Total cost of item, including sales tax

name: cost_
description: Data-quality flag for COST: valid, blank, allocated, imputed or topcoded
observations: Flag codes A-W are listed in dicionario and in the BLS Getting Started Guide

name: pubflag
description: Is amount included in published reports?
